title: Staff Backend Engineer - Licensing & Revenue Platform
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

The Core Licensing & Devices team owns the layer that turns Verkada's licenses into revenue: a double-entry accounting ledger that reconciles every license into daily revenue recognition. This is the system Finance closes the books on and the one auditors trace, so every entry has to be right. As Verkada scales past millions of devices and the business matures toward tighter reporting and audit requirements, this system moves from important to load-bearing.

We're a small, high-trust, high-autonomy team. We give and receive feedback directly, we learn out loud, and we hold a high bar on both execution and written communication.

What You'll Do

• Own the double-entry accounting ledger that reconciles licensing into daily revenue recognition - its accounting model, its invariants, and its correctness guarantees under concurrency, retries, and failure.

• Design and lead the systems behind upmarket licensing: pay-as-you-go metering and billing, fixed-term commitments, and the packaging our enterprise customers buy.

• Build reconciliation and controls that let Finance close the books daily and let auditors trace any recognized dollar back to its source - with the auditability, immutability, and lineage a maturing company requires.

• Partner with Finance, Accounting, Revenue, and Product to turn revenue-recognition policy (ASC 606, deferred revenue, contract modifications, true-ups) into precise, testable system behavior.

• Lead major features end-to-end and bring others along - through design reviews, code reviews, crisp written docs, and direct mentorship.

• Drive operational rigor: strong observability, tight SLOs, low pager noise, and blameless learning when incidents occur.

• Help shape the platform's roadmap toward the company's biggest long-term bets as Verkada scales and matures.

What You Bring

• 8+ years building backend services with strong correctness, consistency, and durability guarantees at scale.

• Depth in financial or transactional systems: ledgers, double-entry accounting, billing, payments, or revenue recognition - you understand why idempotency, exactly-once semantics, immutability, and reconciliation matter, and you've built for them.

• Comfort working shoulder-to-shoulder with Finance and Accounting - or a track record of getting deep in an unfamiliar, high-stakes domain fast.

• Fluency in Python or Go; other backend languages can contribute to your experience, but the interviews will be conducted in one of the above.

• A track record of partnering with Finance, Accounting, or other non-engineering stakeholders, translating policy and ambiguity into systems they can rely on without surprise.

• At the Staff level: the ability to set technical direction across teams, shape shared architecture, and raise the bar on how the org designs and operates critical f

title: Monetization Services Specialist - Pricing Activation
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Finance Operations (FinOps) team is Stripe’s global backbone, dedicated to delivering and continuously improving essential business services - billing and collections, procurement, monetization, payroll, and travel and expenses. We drive company value through data-driven insights, operational rigor, and a relentless focus on excellence. As strategic partners, we shape business decisions, champion technology-enabled solutions, own operational strategy, and collaborate across global functions to enable Stripe’s growth.

What you’ll do

We're looking for a Monetization Services Specialist - Pricing Activation to join our growing team. This individual will help us improve user experience through accurate and timely onboarding of contracts, workflows and deliver improvements in our integrated financial systems with business partners, financial colleagues, and engineers.

Responsibilities

• Own accurate and timely activation of sold custom pricing contracts.

• Own the pricing activation of custom pricing contracts in Stripe’s billing systems, from intake and requirements validation through configuration and post-activation checks.

• Translate legal terms including approved pricing, product, invoicing, and effective-date terms into accurate billing configurations; identify and escalate ambiguous or conflicting terms.

• Perform quality-control and reconciliation checks to confirm that configurations produce the expected billing outcomes.

• Partner with internal systems, deal desk, legal, sales ops, internal audit, go-to-market, engineer and account managers to develop and improve operational processes and programs

• Partner with sales to investigate and resolve user inquiries related to onboarding and rate discrepancy issues

• Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience

• Work closely with other Stripe teams to assist with system implementations for billings, collections, and assist with internal and external ad-hoc audit support

• Help scale and optimize our processes by assisting with the execution of key projects and programs.

• Gain unique insights into how businesses of varying sizes and industries operate and scale on Stripe

• Can quickly learn the Stripe ways of working and make a real impact through process enhancements.

• Be a part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe

• Contribute to or act as DRI for with monthly and quarterly flux analysis of key metrics

• Contribute to or act as DRI for ad hoc projects

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 4-5  years of relevant financial operations/pricing activation experience or 4+ years of strong customer service experience with a degree in Business Administration, Finance, Tech, or relevant field

• Excellent communication and organizational skills, both written and verbal

• Excellent problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems and data sets to make complex investigation decisions

• Strong knowledge of gSuite tools, Salesforce, and MS-Office products and experience working with/analyzing contracts and large data sets

• Independently analyze and evaluate information from various data sources

Full-Time Free Agents

We aim to share stories with our audience that really get them thinking, talking, and sharing them organically rather than relying on traditional SEO. We want someone who is excited about doing things a little differently and has a hunger for finding the next big story.

About The Role

As the Assigning Editor, you will be in charge of the first, and one of the most crucial, steps when it comes to formulating an engaging or thought-provoking article. You’ll lead story sourcing and pitching for our social and viral news desk across multiple brands and spend much of your day digging into the major news stories that people really care about or on TikTok (as well as Reddit and other social media platforms), spotting posts and conversations that have the makings of a big story. To excel, you’ll have a natural ability to spot the story in something that others would scroll straight past and know how to frame it so it reaches a wide audience.

This is a fast-paced, high-volume role, which will best fit someone who is comfortable pitching a large number of stories every day while using data (and natural instinct) to inform decisions over time.

What You'll Do

• Keep abreast of major world events, the latest news in the world of entertainment, and understand how to frame these topics in new and interesting ways that will resonate with our audiences

• Monitor TikTok and other social platforms every day to find stories, ideally before other publishers do

• Write clear pitches and context to give writers everything they need before starting on an article

• Assign stories to staff and freelance writers

• Frame stories and headlines for syndication and social platforms like MSN, Facebook, and SmartNews

• Track performance and use data to refine your pitches

• Build and document discovery workflows, so writers and other editors can become stronger pitchers

• Verify that stories are accurate, credit creators properly, and treat the people in our stories fairly

• Work with the wider editorial team to spot stories that deserve extra attention, follow-ups, or investigation

What We're Looking For

• Experience as an assigning, commissioning, news, trending, or social editor in a fast-moving digital media environment (or extensive experience as a self-pitching writer)

• A genuine love for the weird and wonderful worlds of TikTok and social culture, with a strong instinct for what people will want to read and a passion for exploring new niches

• Syndication and/or social media experience is a strong plus

• Excellent, compelling headline writing without being misleading

• Comfortable working with traffic data and using it to guide editorial decisions

• An ability to work in a fast-paced, high-volume pitching environment

• A strong understanding of ethical journalism

• A strong understanding of US culture and audiences

Think you can spot the next big story before anyone else? Please send us your resume, along with a cover letter that tells us who you are and what makes you a good fit for this role. We'd also love to see three social posts or stories you've come across recently that you think would make a great article, with a headline for each and a line on why you picked it.

title: Talent Acquisition Praktikum (m/f/d)
description:
ÜBER BUENA

Buena (finanziert von Google Ventures) macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs. Ob Suchen, Kaufen oder Finanzieren einer Wohnung. Wir übernehmen deutschlandweit Hausverwaltungen und verwandeln diese in Technologieunternehmen. In den vergangenen drei Jahren sind wir mit 25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern in Berlin zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden.

ÜBER DIE ROLLE

Wir suchen einen Praktikanten (m/w/d) für unser Talent Acquisition Team, um unseren Wettbewerbsvorteil im M&A-Bereich weiter auszubauen.

Wenn wir Immobilienverwaltungsunternehmen in ganz Deutschland übernehmen, ist es entscheidend, in kurzer Zeit Mitarbeiter in unseren Unternehmen einzusetzen, die technologieaffin & lernbereit sind und den klassischen Job des Immobilienverwalters neu definieren möchten. Deine Aufgabe ist es, diese Talente für uns zu gewinnen.

Arbeiten bei Buena bedeutet "Volle Verantwortung" ab Tag eins. Du übernimmst von Beginn an Verantwortung für ein Portfolio von über 500 Mitarbeitern und baust proaktiv “Talentpools” deutschlandweit auf. So stellst du sicher, dass jede neue Verwaltung im Portfolio zu jeder Zeit mit den besten Mitarbeitern ausgestattet ist.

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserer zweiten Führungsebene im HQ, den lokalen Geschäftsführern vor Ort und unserem HQ Talent Team zusammen.

VERANTWORTLICHKEITEN

Recruiting ist ein zentraler Teil unserer Unternehmensstrategie, daher erwarten wir eine stark technologie-unterstützte Arbeitsweise, Outputorientierung und Professionalität im Umgang mit den Talenten.

- 80% deiner ersten Monate verbringst du im Sourcing von Talenten via unserer verschiedener Kanäle. Du übernimmst auch erste Screening Gespräche.

- Du screenst den deutschen Markt systematisch und baust strategische Talentpools für zukünftige Targets auf.

- Du bringst dich mit Gestaltungsideen zu unserem Kanal-Mix zur Anziehung von Talenten in unsere TA Strategie aktiv mit ein.

DU PASST, WENN DU

- Vor Ort in unserem HQ in Berlin (Prenzlauer Berg) arbeiten willst.

- Ein nachweislich ausgeprägtes Interesse an Menschen, Recruiting/Sales mitbringst, d.h. du hast beispielsweise einen erfolgreichen TikTok/IG Account, organisierst Events oä.

- Dich auf mindestens 6 Monate Praktikumszeitraum committen kannst.

- Eine hohe Resilienz in der Direktansprache besitzt, souverän agierst und ergebnisorientiert arbeitest.

- Eine sehr steile Lernkurve in den Bereichen Methodik und Technologie-unterstützten Arbeiten möchtest.

DEINE BENEFITS

- Schnelle Aufstiegschancen in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Startups Europas.

- MacBook & Studio Display.

- Attraktives Gehalt, inklusive 500 € „Close-to-Office"-Bonus.

- 110 € Essenszuschuss und 50 € Fitnesszuschuss.

- Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen willst.

- Tägliches Frühstück und Spezialitätenkaffee im Büro.

WARUM JETZT EINSTEIGEN

- Wir wachsen schnell mit einem kleinen Team: In den letzten 3 Jahren zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands mit ~25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern.

- Wir sind meritokratisch: Wer liefert, bekommt Verantwortung. Unser CEO war vor 3 Jahren Junior Product Manager, unser COO vor 2 Jahren Chief of Staff.

- Wir bauen Buena langfristig auf: Die Wohneigentumsquote in Deutschland liegt weit unter dem europäischen Durchschnitt. Buena wird das ändern.

• Conducts analysis on AI-based outputs to properly compile data on QC Sheets and address any discrepancies from automated QC

• Conducts product pack outs and product check-ins with vendors to ensure Autograph Operations delivers all active cards per the subject list on time

• Responsible for receipt of sticker and on-card autographs daily, to include unboxing and staging of products, data entry into Autograph Operations databases, and secure transportation of products in cages from receipt area to quality control

• Supports the secure storage and organization of high value autographs in inventory room, to include properly shelving on-card autographs in alphabetically order by product

• Mentors and trains less experienced QC Associates; provide guidance and training as questions or discrepancies arise

The Ideal Candidate: 

•  High school diploma or GED required

•  1-2 years of experience in manufacturing or production environments, preferred

•  Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

•  Ability to lift 10-15 lbs. at once, preferred

•  Proficient experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel), required

•  Prior experience with data management systems, a plus

title: Security Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System , das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt.
Hilf dabei, Shopware-Produkte sicherer zu machen, indem du während der gesamten Produktentwicklung Sicherheitsrisiken aufdeckst und reduzierst. Du arbeitest mit den Produktentwicklungsteams daran, Schwachstellen zu untersuchen, sichere Konzepte und Tests zu verbessern und praxisnahe Maßnahmen aufzubauen, die wiederkehrende Probleme in Commerce Core, Services und angrenzenden Produktbereichen verhindern.
Product Security Engineering ist eine Engineering-Funktion . Die Produktteams bleiben dafür verantwortlich, ihren eigenen Code zu korrigieren und zu testen. Dieses Team bringt gezielte Sicherheitsexpertise, eine gemeinsame Roadmap zur Prävention und eine klare Koordination für produktübergreifende Sicherheitsarbeit ein.
Requirements

• Untersuche Schwachstellenmeldungen, Sicherheitswarnungen, interne Findings und Nacharbeiten zu Sicherheitsvorfällen . Bewerte die technischen Auswirkungen und unterstütze dabei, bestätigte Aufgaben an die zuständigen Product Owner weiterzuleiten.

• Arbeite direkt mit Entwicklerinnen und Entwicklern an sicherem Design, Threat Models, Code Reviews, Ursachenanalysen, Fixes und Regressionstests für besonders risikoreiche Produktbereiche.

• Entwickle und verbessere wiederverwendbare Sicherheitskontrollen , Leitfäden für Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler, Tests für Missbrauchsszenarien und praxisnahe Automatisierung zur Erkennung und Behebung von Schwachstellen.

• Unterstütze dabei, für Product-Security-Findings klare Verantwortlichkeiten, Schweregrade, Reaktionsziele, betroffene Versionen und Nachweise zum Abschluss festzuhalten.

• Arbeite mit den Engineering-Teams von Commerce Core und Services an Sicherheitsaufgaben über verschiedene Repositories, unterstützte Versionen, APIs, Integrationen und das Extension-Ökosystem hinweg .

• Unterstütze koordinierte Sicherheits-Releases : Ermittle betroffene Bereiche, prüfe technische Behebungen und stimme dich mit Engineering, Product Operations, Quality, InfoSec und DevRel ab.

• Überführe Erkenntnisse aus Sicherheitsvorfällen und Releases in konkrete Änderungen am Engineering, Tests oder Tools. Verfolge anschließend nach, ob diese Maßnahmen übernommen werden.

• Kommuniziere bei zeitkritischen Aufgaben klar und dokumentiere Entscheidungen in den vereinbarten GitHub- und Confluence-Einträgen, damit Teams den Status nicht aus Slack-Verläufen rekonstruieren müssen.

• Wirke an gemeinsamen Teampraktiken mit und vertrete bei Bedarf den anderen Produktbereich.

Das bringst du mit:

• Fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und Interesse an Produkt- oder Anwendungssicherheit.

• Praktische Kenntnisse typischer Risiken in der Anwendungssicherheit , etwa Schwachstellen bei Authentifizierung und Autorisierung, Zugriffskontrolle, Datentrennung, API-Sicherheit, Umgang mit Zugangsdaten, Injection und Abhängigkeiten.

• Die Fähigkeit, produktiven Code und Tests zu lesen und zu ändern , Risiken für Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler verständlich zu erklären und wartbare Fixes mit umzusetzen.

• Erfahrung mit Threat Modeling, Sicherheitstests, Schwachstellenanalysen oder Secure Code Reviews ; in einigen Bereichen bringst du fundiertes Wissen mit, in anderen möchtest du dich weiterentwickeln.

• Gutes Urteilsvermögen bei der Einschätzung von Schweregrad, Auswirkungen auf Kundinnen und Kunden und Ausnutzbarkeit sowie bei der Frage, wann ein Problem sofort eskaliert werden muss.

• Klare schriftliche Kommunikation und die Fähigkeit, bei unklaren oder dringenden Aufgaben teamübergreifend zusammenzuarbeiten.

• Kenntnisse von PHP sowie mit Shopwares Produkten, Services oder dem Extension-Ökosystem sind hilfreich.

title: Senior Director, Care Operational Excellence
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)
Toast is looking for a Senior Director, Customer Care Operational Excellence to own how our customer support organization operates, end to end. This is a build-and-run role: you will design (and continuously redesign) the people, process, systems, and data that determine whether every customer, from our smallest SMB accounts to our largest Enterprise relationships, gets a fast, effortless, high-quality resolution.
This role sits at the center of our AI transformation of Support operations, evaluating, implementing, and scaling AI across chat, voice, and agent-assist workflows, while also owning the fundamentals: workforce planning and capacity, quality and performance measurement, and a closed-loop voice-of-customer program that feeds directly into our product and engineering roadmaps. You will lead a team, and this is a hands-on role: you're expected to get into the details, run point on hard problems personally, and build things yourself when needed.
Support Operating Model: People, Process & Systems

• Own the end-to-end design of how Support operates: org structure, staffing model, tiering/routing, escalation paths, and channel model (chat, email, phone, self-service, community), and continuously refine it as the business scales.

• Build and run the operating cadence for the function: performance reviews, root-cause/escalation reviews, leadership readouts, and continuous-improvement rhythms.

• Segment design so that SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise customers each get a service model appropriate to their needs, complexity, and value.

• AI & Support Technology Transformation

• Own the roadmap for AI-enabled support, including virtual agents/chatbots, voice AI, agent-assist, and automation, from business case through implementation, measured adoption, and iteration.

• Partner with Product and Engineering as a co-owner of the tools and systems Support runs on: helpdesk/CRM, contact center (CCaaS), knowledge base, and AI/automation platforms, representing Support's requirements and stress-testing what's shipped.

• Evaluate, select, and manage the vendor and technology stack (including AI vendors and BPO/outsourcing partners), balancing cost, quality, and customer experience.

Data, Insights & Performance Measurement

• Define the metrics that matter for Toast ’s support operations, including but not limited to TTR/resolution time, CSAT, customer effort (CES), quality/QA scores, cost-to-serve, and AI containment/deflection rate. Partner with Analytics to build the reporting and analytics and associated insights to drive operations across lines of business, segments, channels, and geographies.

• Build a rigorous quality assurance program (QA scoring, calibration, coaching feedback loops) to ensure consistency as the org scales and as AI takes on more of the work.

• Use data to diagnose root causes of poor experience and prioritize the highest-leverage fixes across people, process, and systems.

• Voice of the Customer & Product Feedback

• Own Product Feedback program in partnership with VOC and other related efforts: capturing, synthesizing, and prioritizing feedback and issues surfaced through Support.

• Build the formal, closed-loop mechanism that routes customer and product feedback to R&D/Product leadership, ensuring it gets actioned and tracked through to impact on support volume and CSAT.

• Workforce Planning & Capacity Management

• Own workforce planning, forecasting, and capacity management (staffing, scheduling, shrinkage, real-time management) across in-house and outsourced/BPO teams.

• Model the impact of AI automation on headcount and capacity plans, and adjust staffing levels as containment rates change.

ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Getting paid is still one of the most manual parts of running a business. Finance teams chase invoices over email, match payments to invoices by hand in spreadsheets, and close the books late because cash data is scattered across banks, payment processors, and ERPs.

Ramp's Accounts Receivable team is building the system that automates all of it, from the moment an invoice is sent to the moment cash is reconciled in the general ledger. We own the full receivables lifecycle: invoicing, collections, payments, cash application, and accounting sync.

We're looking for a senior backend engineer to own core pieces of that system. The work sits where hard engineering problems meet real money: matching messy payment data to the right invoices, keeping ledgers correct to the cent, and syncing reliably with the accounting systems our customers depend on. You'll own projects end to end, from design through production, and work closely with product and design to turn complex finance workflows into software that just works.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Build the payment-matching systems that automatically apply incoming ACH, wire, card, and check payments to the right invoices, even when payment details are incomplete or inconsistent

- Design accurate data models where every dollar is traceable from invoice to payment to general ledger

- Build two-way integrations with ERPs like NetSuite and QuickBooks that stay consistent through retries, partial failures, and edits on either side

- Build collections workflows that help businesses get paid faster without hurting their customer relationships

- Own projects from problem definition and technical design through launch, monitoring, and iteration

- Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code reviews, and mentorship

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- Product sense: you care about the customer problem, not just the ticket, and you push back when the spec is wrong

- Experience designing and operating production backend systems, including APIs, data models, and asynchronous workflows

- Strong system design judgment and the ability to balance speed, correctness, reliability, and simplicity

- A track record of independently owning complex projects and shipping high-quality software

- Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to technical decisions

NICE TO HAVES

- Experience with invoicing, billing, payments, accounting, or other financial workflows

description:
Großer Markt, perfektes Timing: Deine Verantwortung

Mitteldeutschland zählt zu den wichtigsten Gesundheitsregionen Deutschlands - und zu den Märkten, die Digitalisierung am dringendsten brauchen. Wir bei Doctolib machen diesen Wandel möglich: mit einer KI-gestützten All-in-One-Lösung, die Healthcare Professionals entlastet und Patient:innen bessere Versorgung bringt - Praxis für Praxis.

Als Vertriebsbeauftragte:r im Außendienst SaaS / B2B (x/f/m) führst Du Dein Territory wie ein eigenes Business: von der strategischen Marktbearbeitung bis zum kontinuierlichen Umsatzwachstum. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben.

 

Deine Aufgaben

• Territory Ownership vom ersten Tag an: Du trägst die vollständige Verantwortung für Dein Vertriebsgebiet - von der Marktanalyse über gezielte Akquise bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Du entscheidest, wie Du Deine Energie einsetzt, um maximalen Impact zu erzielen.

• Stärke im Neukundengeschäft: Du verstehst, was Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams bewegt - und machst dieses Verständnis zu Deinem stärksten Argument. Du akquirierst zielgerichtet, pitchst mit Überzeugung und bringst Deals konsequent zum Abschluss.

• Datengetriebene Vertriebssteuerung: Du misst Deine Performance konsequent mit Salesforce, analysierst Deine Kennzahlen, erkennst Muster früh und steuerst gezielt nach.

 

Dein Profil

Wenn Du nicht jeden der folgenden Punkte erfüllst, aber überzeugt bist, dass diese Stelle zu Dir passt - bewirb Dich. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Perspektive!

• Nachgewiesene Stärke im Digital Health Sales: Du bringst solide Vertriebserfahrung im Vertrieb von komplexen Praxissoftware-Lösungen (SaaS) mit und verstehst, was Deine Kunden aus dem Gesundheitswesen beschäftigt. Die Dynamik komplexer Sales-Zyklen ist Dir vertraut; Entscheider:innen zu überzeugen ist Deine Stärke.

• Neukundenakquise mit strategischem Blick: Du liebst es, neue Kund:innen zu gewinnen - und Du gehst dabei nicht nach Bauchgefühl vor. Du analysierst, priorisierst und pitchst mit Präzision.

• Begeisterung für digitale Transformation im Gesundheitswesen: Du bist davon überzeugt, dass smarte Technologie den Praxisalltag wirklich verbessern kann - und Du machst diese Überzeugung im Gespräch spürbar. Für Ärzt:innen, für Praxisteams, für den Markt.

• Kommunikation auf Top-Niveau: Du drückst Dich sehr gut mündlich und schriftlich auf Deutsch (C1-Niveau oder höher) aus; Deine Englischkenntnisse sind außerdem mindestens auf Konversationsniveau (B1).

• Präsenz dort, wo es zählt: Du weißt, dass der größte Impact im direkten Kontakt entsteht - bei Ärzt:innen, in Praxen, in der Region. Ein Wohnort in Thüringen oder Sachsen (oder die Bereitschaft, umzuziehen), Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deines Vertriebsgebiets sowie ein Führerschein Klasse B sind daher Voraussetzung.

 

Was wir Dir bieten

• Die Teilnahme an unserem langfristigen Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

• Einen Firmenwagen mit Tankkarte - natürlich auch privat nutzbar

• Erstklassige Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote - maßgeschneidert auf Dich und Deine Karriereziele

title: Manager/Lead, Deal Desk
description:
MANAGER / LEAD, DEAL DESK

ABOUT THE ROLE

As our first Deal Desk hire, you will build and run the function from the ground up.

You will report into the Revenue Operations function and partner with Sales, Finance and Legal to structure complex deals, accelerate approvals, improve pricing discipline and make it easier for customers to buy from Antithesis.

This is a high-trust, highly autonomous role. We are looking for someone who can manage competing priorities, operate with incomplete information and drive issues to resolution without waiting for direction.

A core responsibility is protecting the long-term economics of the business. You will help us close strong deals without creating pricing precedent or commercial terms that unnecessarily erode future contract value or margin.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own Deal Desk day to day, including deal structuring, reviews, approvals and escalations.

- Partner with Account Executives on usage commitments, ramps, multi-year terms, payment terms, renewals, expansions and co-term structures.

- Model ACV, TCV, discounting, usage economics and margin and recommend commercially sound structures.

- Protect long-term contract value and margin by evaluating the downstream impact of pricing, discounts and non-standard terms.

- Identify pricing inconsistencies, approval bottlenecks, process gaps and recurring deal friction.

- Leverage AI to be a force multiplier - find efficiencies and strategic gains in the process.

- Own and optimize DealHub workflows, approvals, quote templates and CRM integration.

- Build and enforce pricing guides, playbooks and guardrails that enable reps to self-serve standard deals.

- Track deal cycle time, approval turnaround, discounting, exceptions and SLA performance and use those insights to improve the process.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

FIRST 30 DAYS

- Learn our product, pricing and sales motion.

- Map the quote-to-cash process and identify major friction points.

- Begin independently supporting live deals.

FIRST 90 DAYS

- Become the primary Deal Desk partner for non-standard deals.

- Establish a clear intake process, approval matrix and SLA framework.

- Publish pricing and deal-structure guidance.

- Improve DealHub workflows and simplify the sales process.

FIRST 12 MONTHS

- Reduce deal cycle time and approval turnaround.

- Improve pricing discipline and deal quality.

- Increase rep self-service on standard deals.

- Build a scalable Deal Desk operating model.

WHAT YOU BRING

- 5+ years in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, FP&A or a similar role in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.

- Experience structuring complex enterprise deals, including usage-based pricing, multi-year agreements, co-term renewals and non-standard commercial terms.

- Experience with DealHub or another CPQ platform, including approvals, quoting workflows and process optimization.

- Experience with Ironclad or other CLM tools

- Strong financial modeling skills and working knowledge of SaaS metrics and ASC 606.

- Familiarity with enterprise contracting, including payment terms, renewals, co-terming and commercial exceptions.

- Strong commercial judgment. You understand that closing the deal matters, but so do its long-term economics and precedent.

- High trust and ownership. You can handle sensitive pricing and commercial decisions, prioritize independently and know when to escalate.

- High EQ with persistence. You can challenge assumptions, push back when needed and keep work moving without damaging relationships.

- Comfort with ambiguity. You can form a point of view, make recommendations with incomplete information and drive toward resolution.

DESIRED EXPERIENCE

- Experience supporting usage-based or infrastructure software businesses.

- Experience building or improving Deal Desk processes in a scaling organization.

- Experience with marketplace transactions, including AWS Marketplace, is a plus.

title: Portugal Content Specialist

title: Senior Proposal Specialist
description:
The Senior Proposal Specialist is a seasoned proposal leader who owns the largest, most complex, high-value pursuits (RFPs, RFIs, RFQs and similar solicitations) from assignment through submission and post-submission. As the "quarterback" of each pursuit, the role coordinates all resources across sales, technical, pricing, contracts, legal, program management, partners and vendors with a high degree of independence.
An expert persuasive writer and disciplined project manager, the Senior Proposal Specialist uses the content library and company-approved generative AI tools to produce compliant, win-focused responses efficiently. The role also serves as a coach, mentor and process leader for the department, with the goal of increasing win rates and revenue.
What You Will Do:

Opportunity Assessment & Planning

• Lead the largest, most complex and high-value pursuits, including multi-volume and high-dollar bids.

• Analyze requirements, evaluation criteria and risks; build compliance matrices mapping each to an owner.

• Research the customer, incumbent and competition, and inform sales-led bid/no-bid decisions.

Proposal Leadership & Project Management

• Run the kickoff, build the schedule backward from the due date, define roles and track risks and actions.

• Manage many concurrent proposals with little oversight; hold contributors accountable without authority.

• Serve as the escalation point for difficult pursuits and their schedule, resource and compliance issues.

Color Team Review Process

• Lead Kickoff, Pink, Red, Gold and White reviews; coordinate Green (pricing), owned by sales or technical leads.

• Drive reviewer comments to closure and serve as expert reviewer on other team members' pursuits.

Strategy, Win Themes & Writing

• Shape win strategy, themes, discriminators and value propositions with the opportunity team.

• Write executive summaries and advise sales leadership on win themes and proposal strength.

• Write persuasive, accurate, compliant content in one voice, aligned to evaluation criteria for easy scoring.

AI & Content Library

• Use approved generative AI tools to analyze solicitations, draft and refine content and speed up reviews.

• Verify AI output, protect confidential data, champion AI adoption and grow the content library.

Compliance, Production & Submission

• Ensure compliance with forms, certifications and page limits; manage final assembly, QC and on-time submission.
Post-Submission Support

• Lead debriefs and lessons-learned sessions and share findings with the team.

• Play a stronger supporting role in clarifications, Q&A, orals, BAFOs, protests, award transition and close-out.

Coaching, Mentoring & Team Development

• Coach and mentor Proposal Specialists and junior staff, modeling best practices as a go-to expert.

• Have new hires shadow live pursuits; shadow junior members and review and edit their work.

• Support onboarding and training for new team members.

Department Initiatives & Process Improvement

• Lead or contribute to initiatives improving processes, templates, checklists, standards and the content library.

• Develop and deliver training; attend industry days, pre-proposal conferences and professional development.

• Analyze lessons learned and win/loss trends, recommend improvements and share best practices.

What We Expect of You:
Minimum basic requirements

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant work experience.

• Five or more years of proposal writing or proposal management experience, including leading complex responses.

• Excellent writing, editing and verbal communication skills, including strengthening others' work.

• Proven project management skills; able to lead large cross-functional teams without direct authority.

• Ability to manage multiple complex, deadline-driven projects at once with little oversight.

• Strong attention to detail and a focus on compliance.

• Proficiency with generative AI tools and the ability to help others adopt them.

title: Head of Tax Information Reporting
description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

OKX is hiring a Head of Tax Information Reporting to build and run our global tax information reporting function. The function covers the OECD Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF), the EU's DAC8 directive, the amended Common Reporting Standard (CRS 2.0), FATCA, and US Form 1099-DA across multiple reporting entities and a large global user base, with annual reporting across the EU, Brazil, and other CARF jurisdictions.

Most of the work is data: getting the right user, transaction, and balance data out of our platform, reconciling it, and turning it into accurate filings. You will own the relationship with our reporting vendor, the data specification that feeds it, and the quality checks that decide whether a file goes out.

You will run a central function that owns policy, data, vendor, QA, and submission for every entity in scope. Each reporting entity names an accountable signatory. Local compliance and entity leads are consulted on local requirements and support registration where the law requires a local filer. You will work closely with Product, Data Engineering, Finance Operations, Group Tax, Legal, Data Privacy, and the local entity leads.

Location: remote available, with a strong preference for the US or EU. Some travel to OKX offices.

What You'll Be Doing

•
Own the end-to-end CARF, DAC8, CRS 2.0, FATCA, and 1099-DA reporting cycle for every OKX entity in scope: population definition, self-certification coverage, data extraction and reconciliation, file production, QA, filing, corrections, and tax authority queries.

•
Define and own the data specification that feeds the tax platform vendor: which users, which transactions, which balances, how they are aggregated by user and jurisdiction, and how they reconcile to the ledger. Work with Product and Data Engineering to build and test the pipeline.

•
Build and run the QA framework. Reconcile every file to source, validate it against the OECD XML schema and local variants, sample-test self-certification reasonableness checks, and run cross-entity consistency checks for users who hold accounts with more than one OKX entity. Nothing files without your release.

•
Manage the tax platform vendor: contract scope, delivery calendar, test cycles, output validation, issue resolution, and the annual renewal decision.

•
Set the group reporting policy and interpret the regimes for OKX: reportable crypto-assets, transfers to unhosted wallets, staking and reward income, retail payment thresholds, residency tie-breakers, and TIN rules, exercising independent technical judgment, supported by Legal and external tax advisers.

•
Own the global tax self-certification design in onboarding, including validation rules, refresh triggers, and the backlog remediation program for existing users, working with Compliance and Product.

•
Define the process for restricting undocumented accounts under DAC8 and CARF, including reason codes and customer communications, with restrictions applied automatically in Product and monitored by the central team.

•
Maintain the entity-by-entity readiness tracker covering domestic enactment, registration, self-certification coverage, and deadlines. Report weekly to the CCO and monthly to the CARF steering committee.

•

Design, build, and ship high-quality product experiences. Own key surfaces end to end, from concept through production. Write elegant, well-tested code - we have a real test suite and we intend to keep it that way.

•
Work across the stack. Follow a feature from the interface through the API to the database. No handoffs, no waiting on another team.

•
Work AI-first with Cursor and Claude Code. Use LLMs as your starting point. Draft intent, explore implementations, scaffold components, and refactor with AI in the loop. Apply your own judgment to meet the quality bar healthcare demands.

•
Prototype fast and validate with real users. Build and test quickly with real patients and care teams. Use what you learn to refine before fully committing - especially in sensitive clinical contexts where getting it right matters.

•
Build for scale and own the codebase. Translate product needs into reusable, well-architected patterns that make the next feature faster to ship.

•
Make automation legible and trustworthy. Build systems that clearly communicate what AI and automation are doing on behalf of patients and providers. Earn trust through transparency, reliability, and thoughtful defaults.

•
Champion performance, accessibility, and reliability. Ship work that is fast, robust, and accessible. Partner across the team to debug, optimize, and raise the bar over time.

•
Share AI-native workflows. Document prompts, patterns, and workflows that work, so we move faster together without cutting corners that matter to patient outcomes.

Requirements
Who We're Looking For
The ideal candidate is a full-stack generalist, and has experience taking a product from 0-1 product. We're looking for someone who's entrepreneurial and willing to roll up their sleeves to get the work done, and passionate about our mission to build a platform that will intensely disrupt the healthcare industry.
• You have 1+ years of experience
• You have knowledge or experience with:

• SST

• Drizzle

• Node

• AWS Services (SQS, EventBridge, Lambda etc..)

• SQL Databases

• Problem solving

• Database Schema Design

• You can work independently and are comfortable owning entire projects and or large areas of the code base
• Strong experience in building paid products and services is preferred.
• You are a strong communicator - you are able to clearly articulate technical problems, constraints and timelines.
• You are comfortable working in a fast-paced, unstructured, startup environment.

title: Co-Op, Editorial Content
description:
Your Impact at LILA

The Editorial Content Co-Op joins Lila's Communications team to help tell the story of the company's scientific work across life sciences, materials science, and AI research. Output is published on lila.ai/news and Lila's social channels.

The co-op writes and produces content end to end: drafting articles and social copy, interviewing scientists about their work, scripting and producing short-form video, and building visuals that make complex science legible. They also contribute to content planning and launch strategy, and support occasional team events.

This is a good fit for a candidate who writes clearly about scientific subjects and wants real newsroom-style reps alongside working scientists. The co-op works directly with the editorial team, all former journalists, and reports to the hiring manager. The term runs January through May, based on site in Cambridge at our One Charles Park and Alewife offices.

If you do not check every box below but bring strong curiosity, grit, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, we would love to hear from you.

What You'll Be Building

• Draft articles, explainers, and social copy about Lila's scientific work

• Interview scientists and engineers, then turn those conversations into accurate stories

• Assist in producing short-form video, from concept through script and final cut

• Assist in building visuals and graphics that make scientific concepts legible to general readers

• Contribute to the editorial calendar and launch plans for upcoming content

• Fact-check drafts with internal experts before publication

• Support occasional team events, including on-site coverage and recaps

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Enrolled in a degree program or recently graduated

• Strong writing samples in science, technology, or news reporting

• Ability to explain scientific subjects accurately to non-expert readers

• Comfort interviewing subject-matter experts and working from primary sources

• Precision with sourcing, fact-checking, and style consistency

• Available for the full January through May term, on site in Cambridge

Bonus Points For

• Coursework in biology, chemistry, materials science, physics, or computer science

• Experience with video production and editing tools

• Familiarity with design tools for graphics, diagrams, or data visuals

• Student newspaper, magazine, or science communication experience

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy .

title: Legal Counsel
description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca 's rapid growth. If you align with our core values-Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable-and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:
As Legal Counsel, you’ll help Alpaca navigate complex regulatory frameworks as we design and launch innovative financial products and services. You’ll provide practical, business-oriented legal guidance across U.S. broker-dealer regulation, digital assets, payments, and other evolving areas of financial services.
You’ll partner closely with teams across Product, Brokerage, Crypto, Compliance, AML, Sales, and Success, supporting everything from product and regulatory reviews to agreements, policies, regulatory engagement, and disputes. This is a highly cross-functional role with the opportunity to help shape how Alpaca scales in a fast-moving regulatory environment.

Job Responsibilities

• Navigate complex regulatory frameworks to help the business design and implement innovative financial products and services.

• Lead legal reviews of product design, marketing, and customer onboarding processes to ensure compliance with applicable regulations while enabling business growth.

• Support other areas of the business, such as digital assets, payments, and data privacy, as needed.

• Advise on the application of new or anticipated legal requirements and regulatory guidance to the firm’s systems, policies, and procedures.

• Monitor regulatory developments at relevant governmental agencies and self-regulatory organizations, including the SEC, FINRA, CFTC, FinCEN, and OFAC.

• Support the company’s engagement with regulators, including the SEC, FINRA, and other agencies.

• Draft agreements, disclosures, policies, and procedures.

• Conduct legal research and analysis on novel questions and provide clear, practical guidance to internal stakeholders.

• Manage litigation, arbitration, and other disputes, including developing case strategy, coordinating with outside counsel, responding to claims and discovery, and advising the business on risk and resolution options.

• Partner cross-functionally with teams outside of Legal, including the firm’s Product, Brokerage, Crypto, Compliance, Anti-Money Laundering, Sales, and Success functions.

Required Qualifications and Experience

• J.D. degree (or foreign equivalent) and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar.

•
5-7+ years of legal experience , with at least 3 years focused on U.S. broker-dealer regulation, including the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, regulations

title: People Systems Analyst
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

At Snowflake, our People team is the backbone of an extraordinary employee experience. As a People Systems Analyst on the People Technology team, you'll serve as a key business systems partner - bridging the gap between our People Operations stakeholders and the platforms that power their work. You'll lead discovery, drive requirements, own testing, and see projects through from kickoff to hypercare - ensuring our HR and talent systems scale with the speed and complexity of Snowflake.

This is a hybrid role based in our Menlo Park, CA, Dublin, CA, or Bellevue, WA offices with a minimum of 3 days per week in-office attendance required.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Partner closely with People Operations, Talent Acquisition, and HR stakeholders to conduct discovery, translate business needs into clear requirements, and recommend system solutions

- Lead end-to-end project delivery for system implementations and enhancements - including requirements gathering, solution design, UAT planning and execution, cutover coordination, go-live deployment, and hypercare support

- Create and own test plans, test scripts, and defect tracking; lead structured testing cycles and coordinate cross-functional testers to ensure quality outcomes before every release

- Administer, configure, and support HR systems day-to-day, including ServiceNow HRSD and our Applicant Tracking System (Ashby), resolving production issues and delivering on enhancement requests

- Triage and manage the support queue - troubleshooting system issues, researching root causes, routing escalations, and communicating resolution timelines to stakeholders

- Ensure data integrity across HR platforms and downstream systems; adhere to data governance, compliance, and security policies

- Document processes, configuration decisions, and procedures; assist with end-user training and quick reference guide creation

- Leverage AI tools to improve, automate, and operationalize tasks and processes across the People Systems function

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

- 4+ years of hands-on business systems analyst experience in HR technology, including discovery, requirements documentation, testing, and deployment ownership on a project basis

- Experience supporting system implementations in a high-growth, global environment

- Demonstrated ability to lead UAT and regression testing - writing test scripts, organizing testers, tracking defects, and driving issues to resolution

- Experience with cutover planning, go-live coordination, and hypercare support for system implementations or major releases

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications and communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a methodical, detail-oriented approach to documentation and process design

- Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and evolving priorities while maintaining quality and responsiveness to stakeholder needs

- Customer-service orientation and a collaborative mindset - you follow up, you follow through, and you stay calm under pressure

- Curiosity and experience experimenting with Snowflake AI tools such as Cortex Code and CoWork, as well as external AI

title: Head of Drone/UAV Insurance Programs
description:
About Tint
Tint enables SaaS platforms and marketplaces to unlock growth and improve profitability through embedded insurance. We offer plug-and-play and white-labeled integrations, equipping brands we partner with a sophisticated mix of technology infrastructure, services, and deep industry expertise. Embedded insurance can transform insurance from a product bought separately to a feature of brands consumers love and we are on a mission to make that happen.
Happy Tint customers include Turo, Deel, uShip, Guesty, Montway, Neighbor, and CitizenShipper, among others.
We've raised $30M and are backed by world-class investors such as Y Combinator, QED, Deciens, Nyca, Plug and Play, WIN, Soma Capital, and Pioneer Fund.
About the role
Tint is seeking a Head of Drone & UAV Insurance to lead the strategy, development, and growth of embedded insurance solutions for the commercial drone market. This includes inspection and survey operators, drone delivery, agriculture, aerial imaging, drone-as-a-service platforms, and rental and equipment marketplaces.
This leader will design and scale insurance programs for one of the fastest-evolving risk categories in the market. Working closely with aviation carriers, MGAs, brokers, drone platforms, and our internal product and operations teams, you will build programs that fit how modern drone businesses operate, from per-flight and on-demand coverage to annual fleet policies.
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in aviation or drone insurance and a track record of designing and launching programs with carriers and distribution partners. This role is highly strategic and requires both domain expertise and the ability to build a new market from the ground up.
What you will do

•
Lead Drone/UAV Insurance Strategy: Define and execute Tint’s strategy across the drone vertical, identifying market opportunities and building scalable embedded insurance solutions for operators, platforms, and marketplaces.

•
Design and Launch Insurance Programs: Lead the design and launch of drone insurance programs, including:

• Program structure across hull, liability, payload, and non-owned coverage

• Underwriting guidelines and eligibility criteria (pilot certification, operation type, airspace)

• Pricing and risk segmentation, including usage-based and per-flight models

• Policy forms, filings, and regulatory compliance

•
Build Carrier and Capacity Partnerships: Develop and manage relationships with aviation carriers, MGAs, reinsurers, and brokers to secure sustainable capacity and competitive program structures.

•
Grow Tint’s Presence in the Drone Ecosystem: Build relationships with drone operators, software platforms, OEMs, and marketplaces to grow Tint’s customer base and uncover new embedded insurance opportunities.

•
Monitor Program Performance: Track underwriting results, claims trends, and operational metrics to improve profitability, risk management, and customer value.

•
Serve as Industry Subject Matter Expert: Act as Tint’s internal and external expert on drone risk, tracking FAA rules (including Part 107, Remote ID, and BVLOS developments), emerging exposures such as privacy and cyber, and new coverage models.

•
Represent Tint in the Market: Engage with carriers, brokers, drone companies, and industry groups to position Tint as a leader in drone insurance.

• 5+ years in aviation, drone/UAV, or specialty insurance, with meaningful exposure to commercial drone operations

• Experience designing or launching insurance programs, including underwriting structures, filings, and carrier partnerships

• A strong understanding of drone risk characteristics across operation types, equipment, and regulatory environments

• Experience working with carriers, MGAs, brokers, and reinsurers to structure programs

• The ability to work cross-functionally with product, engineering, operations, and sales teams
